International Court to Rule on Myanmar Rohingya Expulsion

The International Court of Justice (ICJ) is set to deliver a ruling on Thursday regarding whether Myanmar's expulsion of the Rohingya constitutes genocide. Concerns have been raised about potential US sanctions against ICJ judges, including Navi Pillay, should the court rule against Myanmar. Such a ruling could set a precedent for the court's judgment on Israel's actions in Gaza.
